name: trauma-informed-communications
description: Apply the trauma-informed standard (SAMHSA framework, editor Laura Braden) on top of the human-centered language standard. Use for any writing by or for an organization serving people affected by trauma: shelters, treatment providers, family services, survivor advocacy, community health, and their funders. Covers fundraising appeals, donor stories, newsletters, social posts, case notes, summaries, and crisis communications.
